Hi Alex / Claire

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Primary workloads: chat-based customer support + nightly batch embeddings for search.
- Must-haves: VPC/private deployment for production, audit logs, SOC 2 evidence for procurement.

Next step: 30-minute product demo + brief technical Q&A to show a short walkthrough of the runtime and how we handle latency/cost tradeoffs. Can you confirm who from your side should join? For a productive session, we typically include: product/PO, engineering lead, and security/compliance if procurement will be involved.

I'm proposing three 30-min options next week (all PT):
- Wed 2026-08-12 10:00-10:30 PT / 13:00-13:30 ET
- Thu 2026-08-13 09:00-09:30 PT / 12:00-12:30 ET
- Fri 2026-08-14 11:00-11:30 PT / 14:00-14:30 ET

If none of these work, please offer 2 alternative times and let me know which stakeholders you'll invite (engineering, security, procurement). I've attached a 1-page demo agenda and our security brief for quick context.

Thanks - looking forward to locking this in.

Vanessa Ortiz
